 Medicare open enrollment underway, deadline is Dec. 7 
 Nearly 400,000 Mainers rely on Medicare and have until Dec. 7 to review coverage for next year 
 By WABI News Desk Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 11:21 AM EDT | Updated : 12 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Maine (WABI) - Medicare open enrollment is underway, and people covered by Medicare have until Dec. 7 to review their coverage for next year. Nearly 400,000 Mainers rely on Medicare.
 Experts say people should review their coverage even if they are satisfied with their current plan. Premiums, out-of-pocket costs and covered services can change from year to year.
 Medicare Part D plans cover prescription drugs picked up at the pharmacy. AARP says those plans can get complicated.
 Leigh Purvis, prescription drug policy principal at the AARP Public Policy Institute, said enrollees can see changes in several areas.
 “You can see changes in your deductible. You can see changes in your premium. There’s also an increase in the maximum out-of-pocket spending cap, which is now $2,400, so there are a lot of different things for you to take a look at, but what’s most important is that plan covers the drugs you need at a cost you can afford,” Purvis said.
 AARP is available to help with questions about Medicare open enrollment. More information is available at aarp.org/medicare or medicare.gov.
